text:
sara_sales: Hey team — Sandstone wants to run a 2-week POC next month. They want to bring their own fine-tuned variant (xgen-compass-70b-sandstone_v2). Need catalog fit + security ok. Anyone able to check compatibility + pricing delta?

mike_ml: I'm on it. Quick q: is the variant FP16 or int8 quantized?

sara_sales: They said float16 checkpoint. We'll ask for the exact hf repo. Also they'll want KV cache enabled and a 100ms p50 SLO on short chat traffic.

devon_engineer: Float16 is straightforward. But the model size + sequence length may push CPU mem. We need peak seq len & whether they've changed tokenizer.

henry_ops: Also need to confirm KMS flow for Private deploy? Sandstone is asking for BYOK via HSM.

olive_security: Send me their completed sec questionnaire. If BYOK/HSM, we need an enterprise contract + SOC2 addendum. Also question about data residency.

sara_sales: I'll attach the questionnaire when they return. For pricing they asked about hosted vs dedicated. Can we get a rough delta for a 1k rps baseline for 2 weeks?

mike_ml: For hosted, rough token egress + compute — estimate: ~$1200 per 1M tokens for this model. Dedicated: depends on reserved GPUs. I'll ping finance for an exact runbook.

catalog-bot: compat-scan queued for `xgen-compass-70b-sandstone_v2`...
catalog-bot: compat-scan result: tokenizer mismatch -> variant uses custom special tokens; quantization supported: FP16 ok; requires adapter for tokenizer mapping.

devon_engineer: If tokenizer uses extra tokens, we can add mapping layer at runtime. Ops risk: prefix caching won't work properly until mapping is applied.

henry_ops: BYOK via customer HSM: needs IP allowlist + subnet peering. Private deploy only. I'll draft infra checklist.

sara_sales: Action items: @mike_ml run perf estimate, @devon_engineer prototype tokenizer mapping, @olive_security review questionnaire, @henry_ops draft infra & pricing note. Sandstone requested demo week of 4/7. Can we get this ready?

mike_ml: I'll have perf numbers by EOD tomorrow. Also we should propose quantized int8 variant to save cost — ask them if they'd accept small regen quality drop.

olive_security: If they sign the NDA and return the questionnaire, we can do an initial security review same week. For BYOK, legal will need the KMS ATO addendum.

devon_engineer: Prototype tokenizer mapping: stub mapping code:
```python
# map custom tokens to reserved ids
mapping = {"<s_token>": 50265, "<custom>": 50266}
# apply mapping at tokenization stage
```
Will test on sample prompts.

sara_sales: Thanks. I'll loop in the AE @jules_ae. @jules_ae can you confirm Sandstone's legal timeline?

jules_ae: Legal wants 2 weeks to review. They can sign NDA by Fri. Also they're sensitive to pricing and want consumption + committed tier options.

henry_ops: I'll prepare a dedicated capacity quote + baseline throughput numbers.

sara_sales: Great. I'll collect HF repo and questionnaire now. Thanks all :raised_hands:
